property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C calls the callee with the selector of transferFrom(address,address,uint256) for every recipient and thus a recording helper will observe that the decoded first 3 arguments match (from, to, v) for each call; the mutant uses a wrong selector which causes the callee's matching function NOT to be invoked (or the call to be malformed), so a recorder that implements transferFrom(...) will not observe the expected decoded arguments for at least some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector computed to keccak256 of a different signature, causing the external calls to invoke a non-matching selector which may revert on the callee.
